text: Appeal of Order to Comply for 9 Kingswood Road.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Deferred consideration of the Order to Comply, dated August 11, 2020, regarding the property located at 9 Kingswood Road, Folder No. 20 179245 PRS 00 IV, to its meeting in December 2020 in order for the property surveys and photos of the retaining wall, where possible, to be submitted.
